scenarios.pbcopy_script:
#!/bin/sh
REC='@REC@'
n=$(/bin/cat "$REC/seq" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
n=$((n+1))
echo "$n" > "$REC/seq"
printf '%s\n' pbcopy > "$REC/call.$n"
/bin/cat > "$REC/call.$n.stdin"
/bin/cp "$REC/call.$n.stdin" "$REC/clip"
exit 0
